objective: Measure provisional T1 recovery behavior under reproducible seeded and explicit fault schedules without freezing experiment parameters or making post-compromise-security claims.

schedule_contract.generation: Python random.Random initialized with the recorded integer seed
schedule_contract.serialization: canonical JSON sorted by phase, attempt, and fault kind
schedule_contract.identity: SHA-256 of the canonical serialized schedule
schedule_contract.execution_rule: the serialized schedule is the authoritative replay artifact; the seed alone is not sufficient evidence

measurement_rules.contact_time: Measured in discrete contact windows, not wall-clock time.
measurement_rules.security_availability: Reported as separate dimensions and never collapsed into one score.
measurement_rules.recovery_success: Requires endpoint convergence, accepted fresh command, complete telemetry evidence, and an active key not marked compromised in the abstract model.
measurement_rules.indeterminate: Endpoint convergence with incomplete command or telemetry evidence is INDETERMINATE, not SUCCESS.
measurement_rules.secure_degraded: Spacecraft-only activation after bounded confirmation failure is SECURE_DEGRADED while an authorized recovery path remains modeled; this is not a liveness or safety proof.

mandatory_external_review_stop_points: before freezing any experiment parameter or seed set
before choosing T1 as the final treatment
before freezing outcome or metric interpretation
before treating results as evidence of post-compromise security
before implementing concrete cryptography or protocol conformance
before NOS3/cFS evidence is used for publication claims
before manuscript submission or any external security claim
